cohort: The study included 4120 very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) infants born at < 32 weeks gestation, excluding those with pre-eclampsia, HELLP syndrome, or placental abruption as a cause of preterm birth, who were enrolled in the German Neonatal Network from 2009-2012.
finding: PPROM was not independently associated with early-onset sepsis, clinical sepsis, blood-culture proven sepsis, or other major outcomes, but was associated with a moderately increased risk for bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD).
